about: The experiment register and the playbook (from 2026-10-16), read by `node ig.mjs review`. Each experiment has its one change, its pass mark as numbers and its outcomes. A proven experiment does not become a rule: it joins the playbook as a 'boost' (ideas with it score higher), a 'format' (at most its share of the reels), a 'slot' (a share of the slots, like the English slot) or a 'default' (the normal choice, which a reel may break with a reason). The playbook guides the two bet slots in every three only; experiment slots and the wild card ignore it. Proven entries are re-checked every 60 days or 20 reels and go back to the queue when they stop beating the other reels. A failed experiment retires for 90 days and may come back once for a re-test. `node ig.mjs review --apply` (run by the create-reel hook) applies all of this, writes the playbook into the marked blocks of CLAUDE.md and VIDEOS.md, and logs every change in results/experiment-log.md. Claude keeps the queue at 3 open experiments or more, adds a try when a reel tests an experiment, and lists in a reel's script.json (`playbook`) the proven entries it used.
queueNote: The order in which experiment slots take reel experiments, most promising first (my request of 2026-10-21: "reorder the upcoming experiment slots ... so that we can figure out quick what content is getting the maximum positive impact"). Claude ranked them from outside research and our numbers. The slot goes to the first open one that still needs a try; one with "needs" takes it only when that is there. Channel and topic tests (T1 to T4) run on their own reels. A new experiment joins at the place its promise earns, and Claude says where.
